$comment: p95 latency limits (ms) of the nightly load gate (scripts/ci/load-gate.mjs; .github/workflows/nightly.yml: 50 read connections, 10 write connections, 10 s per scenario, 2 API workers on a GitHub-hosted runner). The first matching pattern (regex on the scenario name) wins. The SPEC target is < 300 ms for list pages; cached public reads must be far below it (a 304 revalidation still runs the list query, so it shares the list limit); a payment posts a receipt, ledger rows and an audit row under the company receipt lock. Tighten as the measured numbers improve (docs/PERFORMANCE.md); never loosen without recording why.
